title: PORTFOLIO, COST & CAPACITY CONTROL
hypothesis: The predictive information from the two frozen viable tree architectures remains economically usable under realistic turnover, cost, execution and liquidity constraints.

portfolio.cash_policy: unfilled entry or constrained buy remains cash; unfilled exit remains held; target invested value reserves 2x one-way cost from pretrade equity, the maximum two-sided turnover cost, so the simulation never borrows for transaction costs

execution.price: next applicable eligible research_open after signal plus delay
execution.terminal_liquidation: last valuation date: charge cost on all marked holdings at the final valid close; no free terminal liquidation

turnover.definition: two_sided_notional=sum(abs(target_value-pretrade_value))/pretrade_equity; includes retained-name reweights, entries, exits and cash

liquidity.adv: median(raw_close*volume) over previous 20 eligible, resolved, positive-volume sessions; missing ADV is not valid
liquidity.unresolved_volume: ineligible for fill and excluded from liquidity evidence

capacity.interpretation: conditional illustrative scenarios, not a single capacity claim

classification.VIABLE: 50bps primary has nonnegative mean fold net return, cost monotonicity, fill rate >=0.95, no fold daily MaxDD below -0.60, and base-capacity p95 order/ADV <=10%
classification.FRAGILE: not VIABLE but has nonnegative gross mean fold net return
